verdict.rationale: Consensus supports bulk import of "thousands of papers in one click" into its Library, automated/batch searches via its API, and Deep Search literature reviews spanning many studies at once — all consistent with bulk operations across many items. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated bulk-processing endpoint (e.g., batch query submission, bulk tagging/export, or bulk annotation across a set of papers) beyond import and search-at-scale. Missing for 10: explicit bulk API operations spec (batch requests/results), evidence of bulk export/annotation actions, and independent confirmation of large-scale throughput limits.
